title: French bombing of the Greenpeace boat in Auckland Harbor

tellings.quote: was blown up by the DGSE, French intelligence, in an intelligence operation slap-bang in the middle of Auckland Harbor.

plain: In 1985 a boat belonging to Greenpeace, the environmental campaign group, was blown up in Auckland Harbor in New Zealand by French intelligence, the agency known as the DGSE, in what the teller calls an intelligence operation "slap-bang in the middle of Auckland Harbor." The journalist Ross Coulthart brings it up on Michels' show as an example of what spy agencies are willing to do, even in a friendly country's harbor.
